description: Models how stacked SAFEs convert at a priced round and what the founders keep, including the option pool top-up (pool in the pre-money or post-money). Same math as https://modevc.com/tools/safe-calculator. Illustrative model, not legal or tax advice.

existing_pool_pct.description: Option pool already inside the initial shares, in percent. Web default 5.

founder_split_pct.description: Your share of the founder block, in percent. Web default 50.

initial_shares.description: Fully diluted shares before the SAFEs convert. Web default 10,000,000.

pool_mode.description: pre_money: the pool top-up dilutes founders and SAFEs only. post_money: everyone is diluted. Web default pre_money.

priced_investment.description: New money in the priced round in USD. Web default 4,000,000.
priced_investment.zeroNote: the web calculator replaces 0 with its default

priced_pre_money.description: Priced round pre-money valuation in USD. Web default 16,000,000.
priced_pre_money.zeroNote: the web calculator replaces 0 with its default

safes.description: The SAFEs to convert. Omit to use the web calculator example of two SAFEs.

type.description: post = post-money SAFE (default), pre = pre-money SAFE approximation.

valuation_cap.description: Valuation cap in USD. 0 or omitted means uncapped: the priced round pre-money is used, as the web calculator does.

target_pool_pct.description: Option pool size after the round, in percent. Web default 10.
target_pool_pct.zeroNote: the web calculator replaces 0 with its default

name: calc_safe_dilution
title: SAFE Conversion and Dilution Calculator
